subject: Abigail Dickson City Council Platform
overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed City Council candidate Abigail Dickson regarding their history of community organizing and their policy priorities for the city. Dickson discussed housing affordability, city charter reform, and climate resiliency ahead of the November municipal election.

items.title: Candidate background and community organizing
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca introduced Abigail Dickson and summarized their local background as a founder of youth theater and LGBTQ support groups.

items.title: Housing affordability and displacement
items.summary: Dickson identified housing affordability as their primary campaign issue, advocating for municipal policy actions to stabilize renters and prevent resident displacement.

items.title: City charter review and ward representation
items.summary: The candidate proposed a charter review to establish ward-based representation for city council seats to improve neighborhood equity and reduce barriers for new candidates.

items.title: Climate action and infrastructure resiliency
items.summary: Dickson emphasized the need for municipal-level climate mitigation and infrastructure improvements to prepare the city for flooding and environmental events.

items.title: Voter engagement and election deadlines
items.summary: The interview concluded with a call for increased voter participation and youth involvement in local government as early voting begins.
